# AGENTS.md — AI Packaging Reliability Copilot
# Generated by IBM Bob /init | Updated: 2026-05-03

## Project Overview

**AI Packaging Reliability Copilot** — Real-time semiconductor packaging monitoring system
powered by IBM Bob as the core AI development partner.

- **Theme**: Turn idea into impact faster (IBM Bob Dev Day Hackathon 2026)
- **Domain**: Semiconductor packaging reliability (die attach → wire bonding → molding → curing → inspection)
- **Backend**: FastAPI 0.104 on port 8000
- **Frontend**: Streamlit 1.28 on port 8501
- **ML**: scikit-learn 1.3.2 — ensemble VotingClassifier (RF + GradientBoosting) + IsolationForest anomaly detector
- **DB**: SQLite (`packaging.db`) via SQLAlchemy

---

## How to Run

```bash
# Start both backend + frontend (recommended)
python run.py

# OR separately:
python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
streamlit run frontend/dashboard.py

# Open dashboard
http://localhost:8501

# API docs
http://localhost:8000/docs
```

## Architecture

```
Dashboard (Streamlit :8501)
    ↕ HTTP/REST
FastAPI Backend (:8000)
    ├── /data   — process data CRUD
    ├── /ml     — predictions, explanations
    ├── /copilot — NL queries, root cause, optimize
    └── /alerts — alert management
         ↕
Intelligence Layer
    ├── CopilotService (8 NL handlers)
    ├── ModelInference (ensemble + anomaly)
    └── FeatureEngineer (49 features)
         ↕
Data Layer
    ├── SQLite (packaging.db)
    └── MockDataGenerator (33 params)
```

## Process Stages & Parameters

| Stage | Key Parameters | Normal Range |
|-------|---------------|-------------|
| Die Attach | die_temperature, die_void_percentage, die_placement_accuracy | 178–192°C, 0–3%, 0–10μm |
| Wire Bonding | wire_bonding_force, wire_pull_strength, wire_loop_height | 40–52gf, 8–15gf, 215–240μm |
| Molding | mold_temperature, mold_pressure, mold_voids | 172–180°C, 6.5–7.8MPa, 0–1% |
| Curing | cure_temperature, cure_time, cure_uniformity | 178–184°C, 140–165min, 0.5–2°C |
| Inspection | inspect_reliability_score, inspect_defect_count | 92–100%, 0 |

---

## ML Model

- **Type**: `CalibratedClassifierCV(VotingClassifier([RandomForest, GradientBoosting]))` + `IsolationForest`
- **Classes**: GOOD / WARNING / SEVERE
- **Features**: 49 engineered (raw + ratios + stage health + interaction terms)
- **Test accuracy**: ~90.75% (random_forest baseline); retrain with `python ml/training/train.py` for ensemble
- **Saved models**: `ml/saved_models/model_latest.joblib`, `feature_engineer_latest.joblib`

---

## AI Copilot

`CopilotService.process_query(query, context)` routes to one of 8 handlers:

| Handler | Trigger keywords | What it returns |
|---------|-----------------|-----------------|
| `health` | health, status, overall | Stage scores, overall health % |
| `why` / `root_cause` | why, cause, reason, severe | Abnormal params with deviation analysis |
| `forecast` | forecast, predict, next, trend | Linear regression on history buffer |
| `recommendation` | recommend, fix, improve, optimize | Ranked actionable fixes per stage |
| `explain` | explain, feature, importance | Top contributing features |
| `analyze` | analyze, stage, die, wire, mold | Stage-specific deep analysis |
| `compare` | compare, vs, versus, history | Current vs historical baseline |
| `general` | (fallback) | Manufacturing domain Q&A |

**watsonx.ai optional**: Set `WATSONX_API_KEY` + `WATSONX_PROJECT_ID` env vars to route
responses through IBM Granite model (`ibm/granite-13b-instruct-v2`). Falls back to rule-based engine when not set.
